description: This file defines the AzureBlobGrainStorage class, a storage provider for Orleans that uses Azure Blob Storage to persist grain state in JSON format. It includes methods for reading, writing, and clearing grain state, initialization logic, and extensive logging.

classes.name: AzureBlobGrainStorage
classes.description: A storage provider class for persisting grain state data to Azure Blob Storage, supporting read, write, clear operations, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads grain state data from Azure Blob Storage and updates the grain state object.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Serializes and writes grain state data to Azure Blob Storage.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Clears or deletes the grain state from Azure Blob Storage.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the storage provider to the silo lifecycle for initialization.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the storage provider, sets up the Azure Blob client and container factory.

methods.name: ConvertToStorageFormat
methods.description: Serializes grain state to storage format (BinaryData).

methods.name: ConvertFromStorageFormat
methods.description: Deserializes stored BinaryData content back to grain state.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of a grain state object.
